organism_context: DDT-degrading bacteria (KEGG map00351)
rationale: KEGG R05480 carries no EC, no KO and an explicit comment that it is a 'multi-step reaction (decarboxylation and dechlorination)', so no single protein catalyses it; no literature assigns an enzyme to 2-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,3-dichloropropenoate -> 4-chloroacetophenone.
direction_note: Catabolic flux in DDT degradation runs propenoate -> 4-chloroacetophenone (decarboxylation + dechlorination, effectively irreversible), i.e. ModelSEED's forward sense, not the recommended reverse.

enzyme_name: styrene monooxygenase (two-component StyA/StyB; naturally fused StyA2B in Rhodococcus opacus 1CP)
organism_context: Fused single chain (StyA2B) in Rhodococcus opacus 1CP and relatives; two separate polypeptides (StyA + StyB) in Pseudomonas putida CA-3 and most styrene degraders
rationale: The lumped ModelSEED reaction (NADPH + O2 + FAD + styrene -> styrene oxide) requires both the flavin-reductase and the epoxidase half-reactions; in R. opacus 1CP these sit on one naturally fused self-sufficient polypeptide, StyA2B, so it counts as bifunctional by lineage, while the canonical StyA+StyB system is two separate proteins (not a complex, they exchange free FADH2).
direction_note: An O2-consuming flavin monooxygenation is physiologically irreversible toward styrene oxide, so the forward (LLM) direction is the only feasible one; the recommended reverse would require styrene oxide to reduce NADP+ and release O2.

organism_context: Dehalococcoides mccartyi strains VS (VcrA) and BAV1 (BvcA)
rationale: Reductive dehalogenases are RdhA catalytic polypeptides carrying one corrinoid and two [4Fe-4S] clusters with a single reductive dehalogenation activity; the associated RdhB is a small membrane anchor, not a second catalytic domain, so this is a membrane-anchored single-activity enzyme (broad chloroethene substrate range is promiscuity, not bifunctionality).
direction_note: Organohalide respiration is a strongly exergonic, physiologically irreversible reductive dechlorination (VC -> ethene + Cl-), which is ModelSEED's forward sense; the ModelSEED stub omits the 2-electron donor, so the recommended reverse direction would amount to chlorinating ethene.

organism_context: Dehalogenimonas sp. strain WBC-2 (TdrA); also Dehalococcoides mccartyi RdhA enzymes
rationale: TdrA is the identified trans-DCE reductive dehalogenase, a single RdhA-type corrinoid/[4Fe-4S] catalytic subunit with one dehalogenation activity; the companion RdhB is only a membrane anchor.
direction_note: Reductive dechlorination of trans-DCE to vinyl chloride is the respiratory, essentially irreversible direction (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would require re-chlorinating vinyl chloride with free chloride.

organism_context: Dehalococcoides mccartyi strains VS (VcrA), 195 (TceA), BAV1 (BvcA)
rationale: A single RdhA catalytic polypeptide (corrinoid + two [4Fe-4S]) performs the dechlorination; VcrA's ability to dechlorinate both cis-DCE and VC is one activity on several substrates, not two catalytic functions.
direction_note: Catabolic/respiratory flux runs cis-DCE -> vinyl chloride + Cl- (ModelSEED's forward); the thermo stub omits the electron donor, which is why the recommended direction is reversed.

organism_context: Pseudomonas sp. B13, Ralstonia eutropha JMP134 (pJP4), Pseudomonas sp. P51; chlorocatechol ortho-cleavage pathway
rationale: Dienelactone hydrolase is a small single-domain alpha/beta-hydrolase-fold cysteine hydrolase with one activity, hydrolysing (chloro)dienelactone to (chloro)maleylacetate; no second catalytic domain is reported.
direction_note: The enzyme is a degradative lactone-ring-opening hydrolase, so physiological flux is 2-chlorodienelactone + H2O -> 2-chloromaleylacetate (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would be enzymatic re-lactonisation, which this hydrolase does not do.

enzyme_name: unidentified (no enzyme assigned to dTDP-3-oxo-6-deoxyglucose C4 deoxygenation)
organism_context: deoxysugar biosynthesis, actinomycetes (KEGG map00523 compounds C11908/C11909)
rationale: No KEGG reaction, EC or KO corresponds to C11908 -> C11909; C11908 participates only in the Qui3N-branch 3,4-isomerase/C3-transaminase reactions, while C11909 is actually made by DesII from the 4-amino sugar, so this ModelSEED-internal step reflects a superseded desosamine-pathway proposal (DesI is a C4 transaminase, not a 4-dehydratase) and has no identifiable catalyst.

organism_context: Streptomyces venezuelae and other macrolide producers; dTDP-D-desosamine biosynthesis
rationale: The transformation is KEGG R06426 / EC 2.6.1.106 (KO K13310), a PLP-dependent sugar aminotransferase (DesV) with a single transamination activity; enzyme identity comes from the KEGG/EC assignment rather than a dedicated characterisation paper, hence medium confidence.
direction_note: Biosynthetic flux runs toward the 3-amino sugar (ModelSEED's forward); note the ModelSEED entry drops the L-glutamate/2-oxoglutarate pair, so its predicted dG and the resulting reverse call are built on an unbalanced half-reaction.

organism_context: Actinomadura kijaniata and other actinomycete deoxysugar (olivose, oliose, mycarose, forosamine) pathways
rationale: The transformation is KEGG R05526 / EC 1.1.1.384 (KO K13327), an NADPH-dependent short-chain dehydrogenase-reductase with a single C3 oxidoreductase activity; identity rests on the EC/KO assignment rather than a paper read here.
direction_note: In deoxysugar biosynthesis the enzyme runs as the NADPH-dependent 3-ketoreduction (3,4-dioxo -> 4-oxo sugar), ModelSEED's forward sense; ModelSEED replaces the NADPH/NADP+ pair with 2 H+, so the eQuilibrator value driving the reverse recommendation is for an unbalanced redox stub.

organism_context: hexachlorocyclohexane / chlorobenzene degradation (KEGG map00361), downstream of R05534
rationale: KEGG R05535 carries no EC, no KO and is flagged as simply 'following after R05534' (itself an 'incomplete reaction, unidentified electron-donor'); loss of HCl from 5,6-dichloro-1,3-cyclohexadiene to give the aromatic ring is generally treated as spontaneous, so no catalysing protein can be named.
direction_note: Aromatisation by HCl elimination is strongly favourable and runs dichlorocyclohexadiene -> chlorobenzene + Cl- + H+ (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would dearomatise chlorobenzene.

organism_context: chlorocyclohexane/chlorobenzene degradation (KEGG map00361)
rationale: KEGG R05536 has no EC and no KO and the pathway notes it is an incomplete reaction with an unidentified electron donor; no protein has been assigned to the reductive dechlorination/aromatisation of 5,6-dichloro-1,3-cyclohexadiene to benzene.
direction_note: Degradative flux runs toward the aromatic product (benzene + 2 Cl-), ModelSEED's forward sense; the recommended reverse direction would chlorinate benzene.

distinct_activities: glutamine amidotransferase class-I (PabA domain, EC 2.6.1.85 partial)
organism_context: Fused bipartite PabA-PabB polypeptide in plants (Arabidopsis, tomato), fungi, actinomycetes and Plasmodium; two separate interacting proteins (PabA + PabB) in Escherichia coli
rationale: Basset et al. showed the plant enzyme is a single bipartite protein with fused PabA (glutaminase) and PabB (ADC synthase) domains that makes ADC, not PABA; the E. coli counterpart is two separate polypeptides, so bifunctionality is lineage-restricted.
direction_note: Physiological flux is committed to folate biosynthesis (chorismate + NH3/Gln -> ADC + H2O), ModelSEED's forward sense; as written the reaction is the ammonia-dependent PabB half-reaction, and since the measured dG is ~0 the direction is set by the enzyme's biosynthetic role, not by thermodynamics.

organism_context: Pseudomonas sp. strain ADP and other atrazine-mineralising bacteria
rationale: AtzB is a homodimeric 52-kDa amidohydrolase-superfamily enzyme with a single mononuclear Zn active site; it performs both deamination and dechlorination, but these are the same hydrolytic substitution chemistry on different triazine substrates at one active site (substrate promiscuity), not two fused catalytic domains.
direction_note: Hydrolytic C-N cleavage releasing ethylamine is catabolic and effectively irreversible in the degradative direction (ModelSEED's forward); nothing in the enzymology supports the recommended reverse.

enzyme_name: melamine deaminase (TriA), an AtzA/atrazine-chlorohydrolase family amidohydrolase
organism_context: Pseudomonas sp. NRRL B-12227 / Acidovorax citrulli (TriA); TriA and AtzA differ at only nine residues yet each performs one reaction (deamination vs dechlorination)
rationale: KEGG assigns R05569 to K05394 (AtzA/TriA family) with the comment 'melamine deaminase, TriA'; these are single-domain mononuclear-metal amidohydrolases, and the TriA/AtzA pair is a textbook case of one activity per enzyme rather than a bifunctional protein.
direction_note: Hydrolytic deamination of the s-triazine ring is catabolic and irreversible (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would re-aminate a hydroxytriazine with free ammonia.

organism_context: Pseudomonas sp. strain ADP; AtzC is a homotetramer (~45 kDa subunit) that accepts N-alkyl ammelides, with linear N-alkyl groups turned over faster than branched ones
rationale: AtzC is a single-activity amidohydrolase with one catalytically essential five-coordinate Zn(II) site, hydrolysing N-substituted amino-dihydroxy-s-triazines to cyanuric acid plus the alkylamine; the N-ethyl substrate here is within its reported range, and Shapir et al. note it is not known to catalyse dechlorination.
direction_note: Catabolic hydrolysis to cyanuric acid + ethylamine is the physiological and effectively irreversible direction (ModelSEED's forward).

organism_context: Pseudomonas sp. strain ADP; deethylsimazine/s-triazine degradation
rationale: Deisopropylhydroxyatrazine fits AtzB's reported substrate rule (a monohydroxylated s-triazine with at least one primary/secondary amine and an amine or chloride leaving group), and AtzB is a homodimeric single-active-site Zn amidohydrolase; the deamination and dechlorination it performs occur at the same site on different substrates.
direction_note: Hydrolytic deamination is the degradative, essentially irreversible direction (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse is an enzymological non-event.

organism_context: Thauera aromatica (oah), Geobacter metallireducens and Syntrophus aciditrophicus (bamA); central anaerobic benzoyl-CoA pathway
rationale: Laempe et al. purified Oah as a distinct enzyme from the had-encoded 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA dehydrogenase, with separate genes; the water addition and the hydrolytic C-C ring cleavage are two steps of one crotonase-superfamily transformation in a single active site, not two independent catalytic functions.
direction_note: The enzyme performs an irreversible hydrolytic ring fission (6-oxocyclohexene-carbonyl-CoA + 2 H2O -> 3-hydroxypimelyl-CoA), ModelSEED's forward sense; the recommended reverse would require the enzyme to re-close the alicyclic ring, which is not an activity it has.

organism_context: PAH (phenanthrene/pyrene) degradation in Mycobacterium, Nocardioides, Sphingomonas; analogous naphthalene step uses NahD
rationale: KEGG R05642 gives only a partial EC 5.1.2.- with no KO or gene, and no protein has been characterised on 2-hydroxy-2H-benzo[h]chromene-2-carboxylate; the closest characterised counterpart is the monomeric ~25-kDa GST-fold 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate isomerase (NahD) of the naphthalene pathway, and part of the chromene/ring-opened interconversion is reported to be spontaneous.
direction_note: KEGG's PAH catabolic pathway flows chromene -> cis-4-(1'-hydroxynaphth-2'-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate -> trans isomer, i.e. ModelSEED's forward sense, so the recommended reverse runs against the degradative route.

enzyme_name: Pur4, presumptive PLP/L-glutamate-dependent aminotransferase of the puromycin cluster
organism_context: Streptomyces alboniger pur biosynthetic cluster
rationale: Tercero et al. assign pur4 to this 3'-keto -> 3'-amino transamination purely from similarity to aminotransferases (KEGG KO K12630); it is a single-domain ORF with no evidence of a second catalytic activity, but the enzyme has never been purified or assayed, so the call is inferred.
direction_note: Biosynthetic flux is toward 3'-amino-3'-deoxy-AMP (ModelSEED's forward); ModelSEED omits the amino donor/2-oxo acceptor, so the dG predictions behind the reverse recommendation are for an unbalanced half-reaction.

enzyme_name: Pur3, presumptive monophosphatase of the puromycin cluster
organism_context: Streptomyces alboniger pur biosynthetic cluster
rationale: pur3 is assigned to this 5'-dephosphorylation only by similarity to monophosphatases (KEGG KO K12634); it is a single-domain ORF with no reported second activity and no biochemical characterisation, so the assignment is inferred rather than confirmed.
direction_note: A phosphomonoester hydrolysis is strongly exergonic and biosynthetically committed (phosphate -> free nucleoside), ModelSEED's forward sense; the ModelSEED entry drops H2O and phosphate, making its large predicted dG and the reverse recommendation artefacts of an unbalanced reaction.

organism_context: Arabidopsis thaliana, Populus trichocarpa, Eutrema japonicum and other plants; SABATH methyltransferase family
rationale: JMT is a single-domain SABATH-family SAM-dependent carboxyl methyltransferase whose only catalytic activity is methyl esterification of jasmonate; characterised orthologs from poplar and wasabi show one activity with varying substrate preference.
direction_note: SAM-dependent carboxyl methylation is strongly exergonic and physiologically unidirectional toward methyl jasmonate (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would be a SAH-dependent demethylation that this enzyme does not catalyse.

organism_context: Arabidopsis thaliana, spinach, rice, cyanobacteria; sulfolipid (SQDG) head-group biosynthesis
rationale: Recombinant Arabidopsis SQD1 converts UDP-glucose + sulfite to UDP-sulfoquinovose as its sole activity; it is an SDR-fold NAD+-dependent enzyme, and the reported 250-kDa native species and its association with ferredoxin-GOGAT are oligomerisation/moonlighting of the partner protein, not a second catalytic domain on SQD1.
direction_note: SQD1 is a committed biosynthetic enzyme running UDP-glucose + sulfite -> UDP-sulfoquinovose + H2O (ModelSEED's forward); the recommended reverse would hydrolytically release sulfite from the sulfonate, which is not an SQD1 activity.

organism_context: Thiobacillus thioparus THI 115; cobalt-containing enzyme built from three distinct subunits (alpha, beta, gamma), evolutionarily related to nitrile hydratase
rationale: Thiocyanate hydrolase is a multi-subunit (alpha-beta-gamma) complex, not a fused chain, and the complex carries a single hydrolytic activity converting thiocyanate to carbonyl sulfide + ammonia; per protocol the catalytic subunit is scored monofunctional.
direction_note: The enzyme initiates thiocyanate catabolism (SCN- + H2O -> COS + NH3), ModelSEED's forward sense; the recommended reverse would synthesise thiocyanate from COS and ammonia, which is not the enzyme's role.

organism_context: Blastobacter sp. A17p-4 (homotrimer, 105 kDa); dihydropyrimidinase-like but distinct in structure and substrate range
rationale: Ogawa et al. purified imidase as a homotrimer with a single cyclic-imide hydrolase activity (maleimide is its best substrate, Km 0.34 mM); its weak activity on cyclic ureides is substrate range, not a second catalytic function.
direction_note: Directly relevant: the purified enzyme catalyses ring-opening hydrolysis (maleimide -> maleamate) strongly and the reverse cyclisation only 'with much lower activity and affinity', so the forward (LLM) direction is the physiological one and the recommended reverse contradicts the measured kinetics.

organism_context: Bacillus megaterium, Salmonella enterica and other anaerobic cobalamin producers (pathway context in ModelSEED is anaerobic adenosylcobalamin biosynthesis, PWY-5507); ModelSEED tags the reaction with EC 2.1.1.131, the aerobic CobJ number
rationale: CbiH is a class-III SAM-dependent precorrin methyltransferase; the C17 methylation and the accompanying delta-lactone formation are parts of one transformation in a single active site, and no fused second catalytic domain is reported for it (unlike the genuinely fused CbiET of the same pathway).
direction_note: SAM-dependent corrin-ring methylation is strongly exergonic and biosynthetically committed (cobalt-precorrin-3 -> cobalt-precorrin-4), ModelSEED's forward sense; the recommended reverse would regenerate SAM from SAH, which is thermodynamically and enzymologically out of reach.
